8.2.3 Setting The Output Voltage

When the adjustable output voltage version TPS63020 is used, the output voltage is set by an external resistor divider. The resistor divider must be connected between VOUT, FB, and GND. The feedback voltage is 500 mV nominal. The low-side resistor R2 (between FB and GND) must be kept in the range of 200 kΩ. R 1 = R 2 \times \left(\frac {V _ {\text {OUT}}}{V _ {\text {FB}}} - 1\right)

【问题】
TPS63020 的可调版本目标输出 3.3 V，R2 取 180 kΩ。用标称反馈电压按式 (3) 算出的 R1 是多少？表 3 给的实际推荐 R1 又是多少？

【答案】

message.content:
根据提供的资料，针对 TPS63020 可调版本，目标输出电压 $V_{OUT} = 3.3 \text{ V}$，反馈电压 $V_{FB} = 500 \text{ mV}$，电阻 $R_2 = 180 \text{ k}\Omega$。

1.  **计算标称反馈电压 $V_{FB\_PWM}$**：
    根据公式 (3) $R_1 = R_2 \times \left(\frac{V_{OUT}}{V_{FB}} - 1\right)$，代入数值：
    $$V_{FB\_PWM} = 180 \text{ k}\Omega \times \left(\frac{3.3 \text{ V}}{0.5 \text{ V}} - 1\right) = 180 \times (6.6 - 1) = 180 \times 5.6 = 1008 \text{ mV}$$
    资料 [5] 中表 2 第 4 行明确给出 $V_{FB\_PWM}$ 为 **1008 m
